quiz.meta.title: How uncompromising are you?
quiz.meta.description: A short, slightly silly quiz about how you build apps, and how much of it you could stop doing.
quiz.intro.title: How uncompromising are you?
quiz.intro.body: A few questions about how you build apps. Answer honestly. We’ll keep score.
quiz.stack.title: First, what are you running today?
quiz.stack.hint: Tap everything your app needs to stay up.
quiz.s.data.q: I prefer corporations controlling my data.
quiz.s.data.yes: Bold. We respect it. We don’t understand it.
quiz.s.data.no: Same. A CARLOS app runs on any server, and its data is a SQLite file you can take with you.
quiz.s.toolchain.yes: More moving parts, more to love. Fair enough.
quiz.s.toolchain.no: A CARLOS app is one binary. Copy it to a server and run it.
quiz.s.onedb.q: I prefer to mix all my customers’ data into one database, so hackers have one target.
quiz.s.onedb.no: On CARLOS each customer can have their own copy of the app with its own database, so a break-in at one can’t reach the others.
quiz.s.idle.q: I like paying for servers while everyone’s asleep.
quiz.s.idle.yes: Someone has to keep the lights on. Apparently you.
quiz.s.idle.no: On Carloku, apps sleep when nobody’s using them and wake in under half a second.
quiz.s.yaml.q: My favourite part of shipping is the YAML.
quiz.s.yaml.no: Deploying a CARLOS app is one command.
quiz.s.hello.q: A hello world should need nine services.
quiz.s.hello.yes: Ten, if you count the one watching the other nine.
quiz.s.hello.no: A CARLOS hello world is one file, with its database built in.
quiz.s.pager.q: I enjoy being paged at 3am because the cache server fell over.
quiz.s.pager.no: A CARLOS app keeps its data and sessions in SQLite, inside the app. No separate cache server to fall over.
quiz.s.hope.q: I’d rather ship every change straight to production and hope.
quiz.s.hope.yes: Hope is a strategy. Not a good one, but one.
quiz.s.hope.no: On CARLOS you can stand a canary beside production and try a release there first.
quiz.s.slow.q: Pages should take a second to load. It builds anticipation.
quiz.s.slow.no: A compiled app with its database in the same process answers in milliseconds.
quiz.s.lockin.q: I want to be locked into my host forever.
quiz.s.lockin.no: CARLOS apps run on Carloku, on your own servers or on a laptop. Move whenever you like.
quiz.s.agent.q: I’d rather my AI agent didn’t know how to ship.
quiz.s.agent.no: The CARLOS skill teaches your agent to build, test and deploy the app.
quiz.s.backups.q: Backups are for people who make mistakes.
quiz.s.backups.no: On Carloku, every change to your database is copied to storage as it happens.
quiz.result.few: You might be compromising. That’s fine. We’ll be here.
quiz.result.count: {before} things to run, patch and pay for. With CARLOS: 1.
quiz.result.cta: Paste this into your agent and it can build one for you.

quiz.share.all.alt: How uncompromising are you? You’re uncompromising. A bright amber light with one block inside it.
quiz.share.most.alt: How uncompromising are you? You’re mostly uncompromising. An amber light at rest beside a short pile of three blocks.
quiz.share.few.alt: How uncompromising are you? You might be compromising. A squashed, paler amber light beside a tall pile of nine blocks.
quiz.pic.data.joke.alt: An office tower. Your data is one lit window on the 14th floor, and a sign at the door says “Visits by appointment”.
quiz.pic.data.fact.alt: The app drawn as a small amber light, with a luggage tag saying “yours” tied to it, and an empty space waiting on any server.
quiz.pic.toolchain.joke.alt: Seven machines in a chain, from build to rollout, passing along one small parcel.
quiz.pic.toolchain.fact.alt: The amber light, an arrow marked “copy”, and a server where it runs.
quiz.pic.onedb.joke.alt: One huge database holding every customer’s data, with one door and a burglar walking through it.
quiz.pic.onedb.fact.alt: Three amber lights, one per customer, each inside its own ring. The burglar reaches the first, and his path to the next stops at its ring.
quiz.pic.idle.joke.alt: Night. Three server racks with every light on, and coins dropping into a meter. It is 03:07 and there are no visitors.
quiz.pic.idle.fact.alt: Night. The lights are dimmed. One request arrives as a point of light, and one light is bright for it.
quiz.pic.yaml.joke.alt: A config file unrolling off the page and across the floor, each line indented further than the last.
quiz.pic.yaml.fact.alt: A terminal with one command, carlos deploy, and the reply “ok”. Beside it, the amber light.
quiz.pic.hello.joke.alt: Nine services wired together, holding up one small sign that says “hello, world”.
quiz.pic.hello.yes.alt: The same nine services, with a tenth underneath, “The watcher”, wired to all of them.
quiz.pic.hello.fact.alt: One amber light beside the same “hello, world” sign.
quiz.pic.pager.joke.alt: Night. The cache server lies on its side, and a phone buzzes on the bedside table at 03:00.
quiz.pic.pager.fact.alt: Night. An outline where the cache server stood, the phone dark, and the light dimmed, asleep.
quiz.pic.hope.joke.alt: A chute running straight into a building marked Production, with a horseshoe over the door and a flag that says “hope”.
quiz.pic.hope.fact.alt: A small canary light beside production takes version 2 first and gets a tick. Then production takes it.
quiz.pic.slow.joke.alt: A theatre with the curtain closed and an hourglass in front of it.
quiz.pic.slow.fact.alt: The same theatre with the curtain already open and the amber light on stage.
quiz.pic.lockin.joke.alt: Your app chained to the host’s building, with a padlock on the door and a sign saying “Check-out: never”.
quiz.pic.lockin.fact.alt: The amber light sitting in Carloku, with its outline waiting on your own server and on a laptop.
quiz.pic.agent.joke.alt: An agent’s terminal saying “built it. now what?”, and beside it a parcel covered in cobwebs.
quiz.pic.agent.fact.alt: The agent’s terminal with three ticks, for build, test and deploy, the CARLOS skill beside it, and the amber light on a server.
quiz.pic.backups.joke.alt: A database crossing a tightrope on one wheel, with no net underneath.
quiz.pic.backups.fact.alt: The amber light, with a steady trickle of small changes flowing into storage.
